notes.title: Minor Update Post Launch
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for buying and supporting the game. It was really amazing to see people earning achievements and enjoying themselves. so thank you so much!

A couple of minor bugs were fixed thanks to feedback from reviews and messages. If you encounter any more please do let me know!

[b]Known issue[/b]
The void attack does not stop when game is paused, allowing you to essentially "skip" it. however due to how much time this takes to execute, for an attack that doesnt hurt you, that will also probably spawn again soon anyway. I think it really isn't a priority, if people wanna cheese they can cheese!

notes.title: Release Date Announced!
notes.content:
[p]Thank you everyone for a great next fest, I really appreciate anyone who took the time to play the game during the next fest and to those who wishlisted it.

Following the fest, I am happy to announce that the full release for Distractor will be on the 31st of July! The game will be 4.99 USD with a 20% sale on launch.

Time for me to hit the grindstone, I'll see you in the coming weeks for more news!

Thomas (Dev)[/p]

notes.title: Distractor Is Taking Part In The Steam June Next Fest!
notes.content:
[p]I am happy to announce that Distractor is taking part in the Steam Next Fest, starting on June 9th.

It is a great opportunity to try the Demo for Distractor, as well as all the other great indie games on show!

I will be updating the demo throughout the fest based on the feedback given, either through my bluesky (linked below) or on the community hub page, so please feel free to comment what your experience was like.

See you at the fest!

Thomas (dev).[/p]

notes.title: Distractor Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
I'm very proud to announce the demo for Distractor is avaliable now!
A lot of work has gone into this project and I'm so happy to finally be able to get this thing out there!

If you have any feedback for the game there is a forum on the disscussions page, or you can contact me directly on bluesky (linked below).

If you enjoy the demo make sure to leave a review! They really do matter!

I hope you all enjoy the game, and watch this space for the full release announcement.
Thomas (Dev of Distractor)

notes.title: Distractor Demo out 28th May!
notes.content:
I am really excited to announce the demo for distractor will be releasing at the end of this month! It has been such a fun journey to create and i'm really excited to get this thing out there! The steam page for the demo is found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3325010/Distractor_Demo/]here[/url].

For those who wish to create content in any  form about the game, I have also released an art pack with our marketing assets, these can be used and edited however you wish free of charge, the google drive containing all of this can be found [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1gaDwUHnJGLL43gOSYQDemudHO2kvK38T?usp=sharing]here[/url].

Massive thanks once again to everyone who took part in the playtest, i hope you all have fun choosing your favourite way to lose!

notes.title: Distractor Playtest is now LIVE!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who participates and leaves feedback. I look forward to hearing about your experiences testing the game!

You can join the playtest through the store page here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3292750/Distractor/

You can leave you feedback either here in the community hub, and by filling our this short form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1FPQRY2ylMxIftKFc-IVKfs9Bm-AOKTCiQtGcqjp5GhM/edit
